apartments.name: Sebastiana (75 m²)
apartments.description: Traced 1:1 from the SVG floor plan: closed 7-vertex perimeter + 7 interior wall segments, extruded to 2.5 m height. Single uniform scale anchored at drawing depth 544 px = 13.0 m (~2.39 cm/px), origin at outline top-left; width works out to 7.15 m. Room names from source labels with user corrections: 'terrace' = second bedroom, east shaft + middle connector = one L-shaped corridor (main-entrance space), hall + bedroom 2 = one space (bedroom 2), 'study' = bathroom (its corridor-facing corner is chamfered 45°, door on the cut edge). Openings: main entrance door on the west wall (y ≈ 6.58) into the corridor, stone-framed entrance (no door) kitchen↔living room, framed doors bedroom↔living room (y ≈ 10.75), bedroom 2↔corridor (x ≈ 6.24), a balcony door on bedroom 2's slanted exterior wall, and a 2 m open passage inside bedroom 2 (no door/window); open double doors living room↔corridor (x ≈ 5.81); three windows on the south wall, which faces SW Sebastiana Street; walls are cut around all openings. Room areas computed from wall geometry; ground marks: street, balcony, staircase, plus subtle perimeter segment lengths outside the building. Furniture from the Airbnb photos: bedroom bed with headboard on the west wall + SW-corner desk (photo-verified via sebastiana_4), bedroom 2 bed estimated against the east wall (no photo of that room).
